multiplicity_note: m = 39 statistical comparisons = 13 per seed x 3 seeds. The 13 per seed are 11 normal-z comparisons plus f5 P01/P10 exact-binomial cells; f4/f8/f10 are deterministic and use no alpha. The "36 passing seed-level id records" count ids, not comparisons; f6 ABSENT removes one id from the executed set but the registered m stays 39. Control is NOMINAL (normal tails).
gate_basis: m = 39 = 13 statistical tests per seed x 3 seeds. Per seed: 11 normal-z assertions (f1_independent, f1_linked, f2, f3, f5 P00, f5 P11, f7_e2e, f7_sd, f7_shared, f9 independent, f9 correlated) + f5's two exact-binomial zero cells (P01, P10). f4, f8 and f10 are deterministic and use no alpha; f6 is ABSENT (no chain channel ships) and is never counted as a pass, which can only lower the realised familywise error.

variance_rules.bernoulli: SE = sqrt(p0(1-p0)/n) at the number of independent baselines n (f1_*, f2, f3, f5 cells, f7_sd)
variance_rules.f7_e2e: the statistic averages six runs of one baseline that share the rate: SE = sqrt((1/128)/baselines)
variance_rules.f7_shared: SE = sqrt((1/36)/baselines) (E[Var K|q] + Var E[K|q] = 4, times (0.5/6)^2)
variance_rules.f9: SE = sqrt(var/baselines), var = 31/432 independent (p = th1 th2) and 1/12 correlated (p = min(th1,th2))
variance_rules.rule: never a binomial over draws x 6: the six runs share the baseline-scoped rate

fixtures.note: the fixtures are the in-repo solvers used by the tools' own self-tests: hardness_forecast._CHANNEL_SOLVER (scale/linked/delegation/pair/duo/surface/ghost) and difficulty_mutation._SOLVER (f9: rule:late, rule:quiet) / _SCALE_SOLVER (f8). Surface and expected sets are recorded per assertion in logs/f1/protocol4/seed<N>/result.json.

familywise_note: nominal Bonferroni control from the normal approximation (and the exact binomial for n*p<5); the 39 seed-level comparisons are the gate, the pooled comparisons are report-only, and the normal tail is not a proven finite-sample bound
tolerance_note: the per-assertion "tolerance: 4 analytic SE" text is descriptive of the interval rule; the GATE is |z| <= z_crit = 3.6558 (alpha/(2m)), and exact binomial p >= alpha/m for n*p0 < 5
